ai.title: Cost report now tracks completed hours and split forecast basis
ai.summary: The subscription cost report type was refined so the observed window is described as completed hours rather than fully covered UTC days, and it now carries an observedHours field alongside new forecastObservationStart and forecastObservationEnd fields. These optional fields let the cost report distinguish the recently measured hours (which may include partial UTC days) from the complete-day basis used to derive the 30-day forecast horizon. The change is confined to the SubscriptionCostReport interface in common/src/types/subscription-costs.ts (+7, -4), and it only adjusts the shape of the report object for whoever consumes these subscription cost metrics.
ai.evidence: In common/src/types/subscription-costs.ts, the comment on the SubscriptionCostReport interface was reworded from 'fully covered UTC-day cost report' to 'completed-hour cost report', and three optional fields were added to the interface: observedHours (commented 'Completed covered hours, including partial UTC days'), and forecastObservationStart/forecastObservationEnd (commented 'Complete-day basis for forecasts, separate from recent measured hours').
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show which consumer reads the new observedHours or forecast observation fields, and it carries no runtime behavior change on its own.

ai.title: FreebuffSession adds env file sourcing
ai.summary: FreebuffSession.create now accepts an env option, materializing variables into a sourceable file within a dedicated temp directory. The tmux command prelude sources this file before launching the binary, preventing secrets from entering the indexed project directory or recorded command line. The stop method cleans up both the work directory and the new env directory. README documents a live smoke test procedure using this mechanism.

eli5.text: When you type "/" in the command-line tool, the list of matching commands that appears works exactly as before, this is behind-the-scenes tidying, not a new feature. Anyone using the command-line suggestions notices no difference; the change just makes the matching easier to maintain and test.
